Si le Candidat est établi en dehors de la Belgique et de manière à démontrer qu’il ne se trouve pas dans au moins une des situations d’exclusion visées aux articles 67 à 69 de la Loi du 17/06/2016, le Candidat (établi à l’étranger) fournit les documents officiels suivants équivalents à ce qui est demandé pour la Belgique. Ces documents doivent dater de maximum 6 mois avant la date limite de remise des candidatures. Un extrait du casier judiciaire de sa société (personne morale) ; Une attestation de paiement des cotisations de sécurité sociale ; Une attestation de paiement des obligations fiscales professionnelles ; Un certificat de non-faillite. De plus, le Candidat sera exclu s’il se trouve dans l’une des situations suivantes : Le Pouvoir Adjudicateur dispose d’éléments suffisamment plausibles permettant de conclure qu’il a commis des actes, conclu des conventions ou procédé à des ententes en vue de fausser la concurrence ; Il ne peut être remédié à un conflit d’intérêts lors de la passation et de l’exécution du marché ;

To support this mission, the Government requires a modern software solution that serves as a relational database and analysis toolset. This toolset is essential for the iSMART (interoperable Systems Management and Requirements Transformation) process and is used to populate, edit, analyze, and manage TDL message data, platform implementations, and interoperability evaluations. 2.0 SCOPE The Contractor shall provide a commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) software solution, including all necessary licenses, updates, training, and technical support. This capability must allow operators to identify and prioritize interoperability issues and potential workarounds within a single system. • 3.1.3.2 Platform Issue Tracking: The software shall provide a mechanism to record and maintain a history of platform-specific issues (e.g., design, testing, operational) through their entire lifecycle. certifications_partner.text: siste 5 år. Med tilsvarende menes her prosjek- tledelse, prosessledelse, sekretariatsfunksjoner eller utviklingsarbeid som har involvert koordinering av flere aktører, oppfølging av mål og tiltak, samt rapportering til styrings- eller beslutningsorganer. Dokumentasjon skal inneholde navn på oppdragsgiver, omfang, innhold og leveringstidspunkt. 2 Tilbyder skal ha et etablert kvalitetssystem Filopplasting tillatt Dokumenteres med redegjørelse for firmaets system for kvalitetssikring, inklusive helse-, miljø- og sikkerhet som er relevant for denne kontrakten. Hvis rutinene er beskrevet i virksomhetens kvalitetsledelsessystem i henhold til ISO9001 eller tilsvarende tredjepartsverifisert system, er det tilstrekkelig å legge ved gyldig sertifikat. 3 Tilbyder skal oppfylle sine forpliktelser til innbetaling av skatter merverdiavgift og andre of- fentlige avgifter Filopplasting tillatt Norske leverandører skal fremlegge skatteattest for merverdiavgift og skatt. Skatteattestene skal ikke være eldre enn 6 måneder regnet fra tilbudsfristens utløp. Tildelingskriterier: Evalueringsmetode: Prissetting av kvalitet med poeng Miljøkriterier: Miljøkrav er uvesentlige Begrunnelse for klima- og miljøhåndtering: Anskaffelsen etter sin art har et klimaavtrykk og en miljøbelastning som er uvesentlig.

Q.1: How long will take security clearance process for instructors and supervisors after the RAM process? Answer: The security clearance process for instructors and supervisors is estimated to take approximately 4–6 weeks after completion of RAM vetting and receipt of necessary documents. Offerors should plan accordingly and allow sufficient time for the completion of security clearances before the instructors and supervisors are scheduled to commence work onsite. The estimated processing time may vary depending on the scrutiny of the submitted documentation and completion of applicable security clearance procedures. The contractor will be responsible for ensuring that all instructors obtain the required security clearances before commencing services, in accordance with the requirements of the RFQ and the resulting contract. Q.2: Can Arizona State University (ASU) apply as the primary partner with NIT, Lahore, for operational management in Pakistan? Answer: Yes. Arizona State University (ASU) may apply as the primary offeror and may engage the National Institute of Technology (NIT), Lahore, as a subcontractor to support operational management and other related activities in Pakistan. ASU, as the primary offeror, must demonstrate compliance with all applicable requirements specified in the RFQ. NIT, Lahore, may support ASU in operational management and the delivery of required services in Pakistan, subject to the terms and conditions of the RFQ and the resulting contract.
